command:
'set -eu
test ! -L /data/local/tmp/lumo-runtime-d12309ef0102673539f2cc2cc8dbc2d6
cd /data/local/tmp/lumo-runtime-d12309ef0102673539f2cc2cc8dbc2d6
pid=$(cat session.pid)
case "$pid" in '"'"''"'"'|*[!0-9]*) exit 92;; esac
printf '"'"'__session_stat__\n'"'"'
cat /proc/$pid/stat
printf '"'"'__session_argv__\n'"'"'
od -An -v -tx1 /proc/$pid/cmdline
pid=$(cat logger.pid)
case "$pid" in '"'"''"'"'|*[!0-9]*) exit 92;; esac
printf '"'"'__logger_stat__\n'"'"'
cat /proc/$pid/stat
printf '"'"'__logger_argv__\n'"'"'
od -An -v -tx1 /proc/$pid/cmdline
test -f logcat.stdout && test ! -L logcat.stdout
printf '"'"'__file_logcat.stdout__\n'"'"'
stat -c '"'"'%d:%i:%s:%f'"'"' logcat.stdout
test -f logcat.stderr && test ! -L logcat.stderr
printf '"'"'__file_logcat.stderr__\n'"'"'
stat -c '"'"'%d:%i:%s:%f'"'"' logcat.stderr
test -f session.stdout && test ! -L session.stdout
printf '"'"'__file_session.stdout__\n'"'"'
stat -c '"'"'%d:%i:%s:%f'"'"' session.stdout
test -f session.stderr && test ! -L session.stderr
printf '"'"'__file_session.stderr__\n'"'"'
stat -c '"'"'%d:%i:%s:%f'"'"' session.stderr
test -f wait.stderr && test ! -L wait.stderr
printf '"'"'__file_wait.stderr__\n'"'"'
stat -c '"'"'%d:%i:%s:%f'"'"' wait.stderr
test -f run.sh && test ! -L run.sh
printf '"'"'__file_run.sh__\n'"'"'
stat -c '"'"'%d:%i:%s:%f'"'"' run.sh
printf '"'"'__script_hash__\n'"'"'
sha256sum run.sh
'
